title: Designing high-Tc superconductors with BCS-inspired screening, density functional theory and deep-learning
one_line: 首个大规模JARVIS-DFT高通量DFPT+ALIGNN深度学习数据库，1058个EPC计算，105个Tc>5K候选
why: 奠基性工作，确立了'BCS预筛+DFPT+DL'三级漏斗范式

title: Sampling the Whole Materials Space for Conventional Superconducting Materials
one_line: 7000个DFPT训练ML代理筛选20万金属化合物，确认545个Tc>10K
why: 目前规模最大、体系化程度最高的高通量+ML筛选谱系起点

title: The Maximum Tc of Conventional Superconductors at Ambient Pressure
one_line: 2万金属电声计算显示ω_log与λ存在trade-off，常压室温常规超导极不可能
why: 直接回答D4关键问题(v)：常压高Tc常规超导的理论上限

title: Accelerating superconductor discovery through tempered deep learning of the electron-phonon spectral function
one_line: 等变GNN(BETE-NET)直接预测α²F(ω)，818材料训练，Tc MAE=2.5K
why: 端到端ML代理预测Eliashberg谱的代表性方法，BEE-NET的前身

title: Developing a Complete AI-Accelerated Workflow for Superconductor Discovery
authors_short: Gibson, Hire, Prakash, Hirschfeld, Hennig et al.
one_line: BEE-NET从130万候选筛出741个Tc>5K候选，其中2个被实验合成并证实超导
why: 目前唯一完整报告'高通量预测→实验证实'闭环转化率(2/741)的工作

title: Feasible Route to High-Temperature Ambient-Pressure Hydride Superconductivity
authors_short: Dolui, Conway, Heil, Strobel, Prasankumar, Pickard
one_line: 高通量筛选提出Mg2IrH6常压亚稳相，预测Tc=160K
why: 常压氢化物设计标志性论文，后续合成落差(Mg2IrH5而非Mg2IrH6)是典型案例

title: 3DSC - a dataset of superconductors including crystal structures
one_line: 在SuperCon基础上补充近似晶体结构的ML训练数据集
why: 问题(vii)所需的关键数据集，但未见专门量化其数据泄漏率的后续工作

title: Accelerating the calculation of electron-phonon coupling strength with machine learning
one_line: 等变NN预测原子轨道Hamiltonian及梯度直接算EPC矩阵元，绕开自洽DFT迭代
why: '加速DFPT内部'路线的代表，区别于端到端Tc代理模型

title: Efficient anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg calculations with an intermediate representation basis and Wannier interpolation
one_line: IR基组+Wannier插值使各向异性Eliashberg计算可行，但仍限于单材料精细研究
why: 说明各向异性方法虽已成熟但从未接入高通量流水线（D1 也列为关键文献）

title: Revised Tolmachev-Morel-Anderson pseudopotential for layered conventional superconductors with nonlocal Coulomb interaction
one_line: 层状体系非局域库仑屏蔽使有效μ*_C大于常规Tolmachev-Morel-Anderson值
why: 直接证明高通量默认固定μ*对层状材料系统性偏乐观（PDF 在 D2 目录）

title: Guided Diffusion for the Discovery of New Superconductors
one_line: 扩散模型生成候选+多级筛选得773个候选，实验合成验证显示预测Tc系统性高估
why: 唯一明确报告'高通量Tc预测系统性偏差'的实证来源

title: Searching Materials Space for Hydride Superconductors at Ambient Pressure
one_line: ML加速搜索15万氢化物候选，约50个Tc>20K，部分>70K但多数热力学亚稳
why: 氢化物专项高通量搜索，规模居前

title: Prediction of Ambient Pressure Conventional Superconductivity above 80K in Thermodynamically Stable Hydride Compounds
one_line: 百万化合物筛选提出Mg2XH6(X=Rh,Ir,Pd,Pt)族，预测45-80K，Pt掺杂后>100K
why: 问题(v)的核心候选材料族之一，与Dolui/Pickard的Mg2IrH6工作互补印证

title: High-Throughput DFT-Based Discovery of Next Generation Two-Dimensional (2D) Superconductors
one_line: JARVIS-DFT筛选1000+个2D材料，165个做EPC计算，34个Tc>5K，含新预测Mg2B4N2(21.8K)

title: Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials are Ready for Phonons
one_line: 约1万个ab initio声子数据基准测试通用MLIP，发现二阶导数(曲率)约束弱导致声子谱系统偏软
why: 问题(iv)MLIP+电声耦合路线的核心瓶颈证据

title: IsoME: Streamlining High-Precision Eliashberg Calculations
authors_short: Kogler, Spath, Lucrezi, Mori, Zhu, Li, Margine, Heil
one_line: 开源工具，支持McMillan-Allen-Dynes到基于GW库仑的全从头算Eliashberg
why: 代表性开源高通量计算工具，但仍是各向同性框架（作者由 D2 报告补全；PDF 在 D2 目录）

title: HTESP (High-throughput electronic structure package)
one_line: 高通量ab initio计算基础设施，示例为MgB2各向同性Eliashberg/Allen-Dynes计算

title: Synthesis of Mg2IrH5: A potential pathway to high-Tc hydride superconductivity at ambient pressure
one_line: 实验合成尝试Mg2IrH6目标相未成功，得到Mg2IrH5
why: Mg2IrH6预测-合成落差案例的实验证据
